verses.original: Περὶ μὲν γὰρ τῆς διακονίας τῆς εἰς τοὺς ἁγίους περισσόν μοί ἐστιν τὸ γράφειν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Peri men gar tēs diakonias tēs eis tous hagious perisson moi estin to graphein hymin
verses.literal: Now . . . about the service to the saints there is no need for me to write to you
verses.literalPt: QUANTO à administração que se faz a favor dos santos, não necessito escrever-vos;

verses.original: οἶδα γὰρ τὴν προθυμίαν ὑμῶν ἣν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν καυχῶμαι Μακεδόσιν ὅτι Ἀχαΐα παρεσκεύασται ἀπὸ πέρυσι καὶ τὸ ὑμῶν ζῆλος ἠρέθισεν τοὺς πλείονας
verses.transliteration: oida gar tēn prothymian hymōn hēn hyper hymōn kauchōmai Makedosin hoti Achaia pareskeuastai apo perysi kai to hymōn zēlos ērethisen tous pleionas
verses.literal: For I know your eagerness to help and I have been boasting to the Macedonians that since last year you in Achaia were prepared to give And your zeal has stirred most of them to do likewise
verses.literalPt: Porque bem sei a prontidão do vosso ânimo, da qual me glorio de vós para com os macedônios; que a Acaia está pronta desde o ano passado; e o vosso zelo tem estimulado muitos.

verses.original: Ἔπεμψα δὲ τοὺς ἀδελφούς ἵνα μὴ τὸ καύχημα ἡμῶν τὸ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν κενωθῇ ἐν τῷ μέρει τούτῳ ἵνα καθὼς ἔλεγον παρεσκευασμένοι ἦτε
verses.transliteration: Epempsa de tous adelphous hina mē to kauchēma hēmōn to hyper hymōn kenōthē en tō merei toutō hina kathōs elegon pareskeuasmenoi ēte
verses.literal: But I am sending the brothers in order that our boasting about you in this matter should not prove empty but that you will be prepared just as I said
verses.literalPt: Mas enviei estes irmãos, para que a nossa glória, acerca de vós, não seja vã nesta parte; para que (como já disse) possais estar prontos,

verses.original: μή πως ἐὰν ἔλθωσιν σὺν ἐμοὶ Μακεδόνες καὶ εὕρωσιν ὑμᾶς ἀπαρασκευάστους καταισχυνθῶμεν ἡμεῖς ἵνα μὴ λέγωμεν ὑμεῖς ἐν τῇ ὑποστάσει ταύτῃ
verses.transliteration: mē pōs ean elthōsin syn emoi Makedones kai heurōsin hymas aparaskeuastous kataischynthōmen hēmeis hina mē legōmen hymeis en tē hypostasei tautē
verses.literal: Otherwise . . . if any Macedonians come with me and find you unprepared we to say nothing of you would be ashamed of having been so confident
verses.literalPt: A fim de, se acaso os macedônios vierem comigo, e vos acharem desapercebidos, não nos envergonharmos nós (para não dizermos vós) deste firme fundamento de glória.

verses.original: ἀναγκαῖον οὖν ἡγησάμην παρακαλέσαι τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ἵνα προέλθωσιν εἰς ὑμᾶς καὶ προκαταρτίσωσιν τὴν προεπηγγελμένην εὐλογίαν ὑμῶν ταύτην ἑτοίμην εἶναι οὕτως ὡς εὐλογίαν καὶ μὴ ὡς πλεονεξίαν
verses.transliteration: anankaion oun hēgēsamēn parakalesai tous adelphous hina proelthōsin eis hymas kai prokatartisōsin tēn proepēngelmenēn eulogian hymōn tautēn hetoimēn einai houtōs hōs eulogian kai mē hōs pleonexian
verses.literal: So I thought it necessary to urge the brothers to visit you beforehand . . . . . . and make arrangements for the generous gift you had promised This way your gift will be prepared generously and not begrudgingly
verses.literalPt: Portanto, tive por coisa necessária exortar estes irmãos, para que primeiro fossem ter convosco, e preparassem de antemão a vossa bênção, já antes anunciada, para que esteja pronta como bênção, e não como avareza.

verses.original: Τοῦτο δέ ὁ σπείρων φειδομένως φειδομένως καὶ θερίσει καὶ ὁ σπείρων ἐπ’ εὐλογίαις ἐπ’ εὐλογίαις καὶ θερίσει
verses.transliteration: Touto de ho speirōn pheidomenōs pheidomenōs kai therisei kai ho speirōn ep’ eulogiais ep’ eulogiais kai therisei
verses.literal: Remember this Whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly and whoever sows generously will also reap generously
verses.literalPt: E digo isto: Que o que semeia pouco, pouco também ceifará; e o que semeia em abundância, em abundância ceifará.

verses.original: ἕκαστος καθὼς προῄρηται τῇ καρδίᾳ μὴ ἐκ λύπης ἢ ἐξ ἀνάγκης ἱλαρὸν γὰρ δότην ἀγαπᾷ ὁ Θεός
verses.transliteration: hekastos kathōs proērētai tē kardia mē ek lypēs ē ex anankēs hilaron gar dotēn agapa ho Theos
verses.literal: Each one should give what he has decided in his heart to give not out of regret or compulsion For God loves a cheerful giver
verses.literalPt: Cada um contribua segundo propôs no seu coração; não com tristeza, ou por necessidade; porque Deus ama ao que dá com alegria.

verses.original: δυνατεῖ δὲ ὁ Θεὸς πᾶσαν χάριν περισσεῦσαι εἰς ὑμᾶς ἵνα ἐν παντὶ πάντοτε πᾶσαν αὐτάρκειαν ἔχοντες περισσεύητε εἰς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθόν
verses.transliteration: dynatei de ho Theos pasan charin perisseusai eis hymas hina en panti pantote pasan autarkeian echontes perisseuēte eis pan ergon agathon
verses.literal: And God is able to make all grace abound to you so that in all things at all times having all that you need you will abound in every good work
verses.literalPt: E Deus é poderoso para fazer abundar em vós toda a graça, a fim de que tendo sempre, em tudo, toda a suficiência, abundeis em toda a boa obra;

verses.original: καθὼς γέγραπται Ἐσκόρπισεν ἔδωκεν τοῖς πένησιν ἡ δικαιοσύνη αὐτοῦ μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα
verses.transliteration: kathōs gegraptai Eskorpisen edōken tois penēsin hē dikaiosynē autou menei eis ton aiōna
verses.literal: As it is written He has scattered abroad His gifts to the poor His righteousness endures forever . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Conforme está escrito: Espalhou, deu aos pobres; A sua justiça permanece para sempre.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἐπιχορηγῶν σπόρον τῷ σπείροντι καὶ ἄρτον εἰς βρῶσιν χορηγήσει καὶ πληθυνεῖ τὸν σπόρον ὑμῶν καὶ αὐξήσει τὰ γενήματα τῆς δικαιοσύνης ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Ho de epichorēgōn sporon tō speironti kai arton eis brōsin chorēgēsei kai plēthynei ton sporon hymōn kai auxēsei ta genēmata tēs dikaiosynēs hymōn
verses.literal: Now He who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food will supply and multiply your store of seed and will increase the harvest of your righteousness
verses.literalPt: Ora, aquele que dá a semente ao que semeia, também vos dê pão para comer, e multiplique a vossa sementeira, e aumente os frutos da vossa justiça;

verses.original: ἐν παντὶ πλουτιζόμενοι εἰς πᾶσαν ἁπλότητα ἥτις κατεργάζεται δι’ ἡμῶν εὐχαριστίαν τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: en panti ploutizomenoi eis pasan haplotēta hētis katergazetai di’ hēmōn eucharistian tō Theō
verses.literal: You will be enriched in every way to be generous on every occasion and through us your generosity will produce thanksgiving to God
verses.literalPt: Para que em tudo enriqueçais para toda a beneficência, a qual faz que por nós se dêem graças a Deus.

verses.original: ὅτι ἡ διακονία τῆς λειτουργίας ταύτης οὐ μόνον ἐστὶν προσαναπληροῦσα τὰ ὑστερήματα τῶν ἁγίων ἀλλὰ καὶ περισσεύουσα διὰ πολλῶν εὐχαριστιῶν τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: hoti hē diakonia tēs leitourgias tautēs ou monon estin prosanaplērousa ta hysterēmata tōn hagiōn alla kai perisseuousa dia pollōn eucharistiōn tō Theō
verses.literal: For this ministry of service is not only supplying the needs of the saints but is also overflowing in many expressions of thanksgiving to God
verses.literalPt: Porque a administração deste serviço, não só supre as necessidades dos santos, mas também é abundante em muitas graças, que se dão a Deus.

verses.original: διὰ τῆς δοκιμῆς τῆς διακονίας ταύτης δοξάζοντες τὸν Θεὸν ἐπὶ τῇ ὑποταγῇ τῆς ὁμολογίας ὑμῶν εἰς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ ἁπλότητι τῆς κοινωνίας εἰς αὐτοὺς καὶ εἰς πάντας
verses.transliteration: dia tēs dokimēs tēs diakonias tautēs doxazontes ton Theon epi tē hypotagē tēs homologias hymōn eis to euangelion tou Christou kai haplotēti tēs koinōnias eis autous kai eis pantas
verses.literal: Because of the proof this ministry provides the saints will glorify God for your obedient confession of the gospel of Christ and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all the others
verses.literalPt: Visto como, na prova desta administração, glorificam a Deus pela submissão, que confessais quanto ao evangelho de Cristo, e pela liberalidade de vossos dons para com eles, e para com todos;

verses.original: καὶ αὐτῶν δεήσει ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἐπιποθούντων ὑμᾶς διὰ τὴν ὑπερβάλλουσαν χάριν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐφ’ ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: kai autōn deēsei hyper hymōn epipothountōn hymas dia tēn hyperballousan charin tou Theou eph’ hymin
verses.literal: And their prayers for you will express their affection for you because of the surpassing grace God has given you
verses.literalPt: E pela sua oração por vós, tendo de vós saudades, por causa da excelente graça de Deus que em vós há.

verses.original: Χάρις τῷ Θεῷ ἐπὶ τῇ ἀνεκδιηγήτῳ αὐτοῦ δωρεᾷ
verses.transliteration: Charis tō Theō epi tē anekdiēgētō autou dōrea
verses.literal: Thanks be to God for His indescribable gift
verses.literalPt: Graças a Deus, pois, pelo seu dom inefável.
